utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to take on?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Mara — could you handle the supply list and check in with anyone who’s bringing tools?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll make the supply list and check in with the tool folks today.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive. What’s the next task?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Leo — could you check the wiring list first and let me know if anything looks off?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll check the wiring list now and let you know if I spot anything off.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what supplies we already have and see what we still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks, Cleo — that’d help a lot. I’ve been a bit all over the place, so just let me know what’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll take a quick inventory and tell you what’s missing, so we can make a simple list.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’s kind of you. I just need to sort out the details first—what day you’re available, and whether you can help with pickup or just the repairs.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m free most afternoons this week, and I can help with either pickups or repairs.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did the repair drive already get the parts sorted, or do we still need to collect donations?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m not totally sure yet — I only heard second-hand that some parts might still be needed. I can check around and see what folks are saying.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Nell. Can you check and let me know if we still need donations?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s getting started soon—folks around here are already setting aside stuff to bring in. If you want, I can keep an ear out for the details.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Tess — that’d be great. I’ve got a few tools I can lend if they need them.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, Gus — that’ll be handy. I’ll let you know as soon as I hear what they’re still needing.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, absolutely — I’m telling everyone about the repair drive. If you want, I can help spread the word and get a few more neighbors to come by.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That would be great, Quinn—thank you. I’m keeping an eye on the locations, so the more neighbors who know, the better.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll get the word out right away. Just send me the final locations, and I’ll tell the neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Kira — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you’re really okay helping out with the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’m in and happy to help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Bo — I’m organizing the repair drive now, and I’m glad to have your help.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure thing — tell me what you need me to do.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Could you help me make a quick list of the items we need and who’s bringing what?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m planning to drop by the repair drive later and mention it to a few neighbors too.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Vik. If you want, I can jot down a quick list of folks to tell.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That’d be great, Eli—please do. I’ll swing by later and share it with them too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the repair drive. I was just about to ask where you wanted me to bring things.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can put a box by my gate. Just bring anything small and useful there, and thank you for checking in.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good — I’ll look for small useful things and drop them by your gate. Thanks, Uli.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help bridge folks for the repair drive—want me to pass along details or help round people up?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, please pass along the details and help round folks up if you can. I’ll be out running errands, so that’d really help.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll share the repair drive details and start rounding people up while you’re out. I’ll keep you posted if anyone has questions.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Dane, I’m hearing the repair drive’s coming together fast—want me to spread the word around the block?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, that’d be great—thanks, Quinn. I’ll help spread it too once I’m back by the block.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll start letting folks know right away, and we can keep each other posted on who’s coming.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still trying to understand the repair drive—what needs doing first?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: First thing, we should make a clear list of what’s broken and what tools we’ll need. After that, we can decide what to fix today and what can wait.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That makes sense. I’ll start the list and jot down the tools we already have.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time window are you thinking for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’d be really helpful—how about Saturday morning, say 9 to 12? That should give folks time to swing by after drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday morning works for me, and I can help spread the word around school drop-off. Let’s plan on 9 to 12.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, I’m happy to help connect people for the repair drive—just tell me what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Jules — I’ll gather the remaining repair tasks and pass them along so you can help connect people.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — send them my way when you have them, and I’ll help match folks up.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Pia—if the repair drive needs anything, I’ve got a few tools you can borrow.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Gus—I'll keep that in mind. I’m mostly worried about how we’ll get everything there without missing anything.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: We can make a quick checklist and pack it by task so nothing gets left behind. If you want, I can bring a couple of bins and help load it up.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m keeping an eye on the repair drive locations and can help track where things are happening. What spot are you checking on?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal — I’m checking the community hall first, then the corner garden shed. I’ll let you know if anything shifts.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, I’ll note community hall first and then the corner garden shed. Keep me posted if either spot changes.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did we decide what time the repair drive starts?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I don’t think we set the time yet—let me check so I don’t mix it up.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks—what time did you find?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help with the repair drive, Cleo — what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Sam — could you check what supplies we already have and note anything we’re missing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll check the supplies we have and jot down anything we still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard about the repair drive, but I’m still catching up on the details. What should I know?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, same here — I’m a little behind too. I just know folks are gathering supplies and helping with repairs, but I’d have to check the exact details.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Same here — I’d probably just ask around at the drive and see where they need help most.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, Tess—this repair drive is still happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s still on — folks are bringing in things to fix this weekend. I’ll let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, thanks for confirming. Just keep me posted if the time or details change.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard any updates yet, but I can ask around while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Ira. I’d appreciate that a lot.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure — I’ll check in with a few folks while I’m out and let you know if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I’m happy to help out however I can. Just remind me what’s needed again?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: We need volunteers to sort donations and help carry supplies. If you’re free, I could use you for either one.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I can do either one—just point me where you need me most. If I forget, give me a quick reminder and I’ll jump in.
